tools.description: Get a security advisory (vulnerability) by its key.

advisoryKey.description: Advisory id, e.g. 'GHSA-29mw-wpgm-hmr9' (taken from a version's advisoryKeys).

tools.name: get_advisory

tools.description: Get the resolved dependency graph for one package version.

package.description: Package name, raw and unencoded (the gateway URL-encodes it). Use scoped or namespaced names as-is, e.g. npm '@angular/core', Maven 'group:artifact'.

tools.name: get_dependencies

tools.description: List every version of a package and whether each is deprecated.

package.description: Package name, raw and unencoded (the gateway URL-encodes it). Use scoped or namespaced names as-is, e.g. npm '@angular/core', Maven 'group:artifact'.

tools.name: get_package

tools.description: Get license, security advisories, and source links for one package version.

package.description: Package name, raw and unencoded (the gateway URL-encodes it). Use scoped or namespaced names as-is, e.g. npm '@angular/core', Maven 'group:artifact'.

tools.name: get_package_version

tools.description: Get a project's OpenSSF Scorecard security posture and maintenance signals.

projectKey.description: Source repository, raw and unencoded (the gateway URL-encodes it). Pass it as-is, e.g. 'github.com/facebook/react'. Supported hosts: github.com, gitlab.com, bitbucket.org. Take it from a version's SOURCE_REPO link (get_package_version).

tools.name: get_project_health
